units.source_text: 当然，这里或许也有一面岛村观看暮景的镜子。

en.t: Of course, there may also have been here a mirror through which Shimamura watched the evening scene.

units.source_text: 他不仅忌讳同眼前这个不正经的女人纠缠，

en.t: He not only shrank from getting entangled with this disreputable woman before him,

units.source_text: 而且更重要的也许是他抱有一种非现实的看法，如同傍晚看到映在车窗玻璃上的女子的脸一样。

en.t: and more importantly, perhaps, he held an unreal way of seeing things, like the face of a woman reflected in a train window at dusk.
